title: Chunni Discord chat link
description: Mod that let your link a Discord text channel with your Minecraft server, so you can chat with them
body:
This mod let you connect the Minecraft's chat with a specific Discord Server's text channel, so members of the discord server and Minecraft players inside the game can keep chatting.

It's a simple mod and the only setup it needs is create your own Discord bot.

To learn how to setup this mod and create your own bot, follow [those instructions](https://github.com/chunnistudio/discord-chat-link/blob/main/README.md)
